description: Estimate what an Illinois home seller nets at closing (a seller net sheet), line by line: owner's title policy and closing fee (Chicago Title 2026 rate card), Illinois, county and municipal transfer taxes for 194 Illinois towns with each ordinance's rounding rule, property tax proration, broker compensation, mortgage payoff and payoff interest, condo 22.1 packet, Chicago water and zoning certificates, survey, and the seller's attorney fee at Abdilla and Associates ($0 when the contract is on the Multi-Board 8.0 form and the firm issues title, otherwise $500). Use it when a real estate agent or seller asks what a seller will net or pay at closing in Chicago or Illinois, or what this firm charges to represent the seller. Read-only: sends nothing to anyone. In hosts that support MCP Apps the result renders as an interactive net sheet the user can edit, copy as an email, and send to the firm.

annual_property_tax.description: Last full-year property tax bill in dollars. Ask the user; the county treasurer site shows it. Use 0 only for a tax-exempt property.

buyer_broker_pct.description: Buyer's broker compensation the seller agreed to pay, percent. Default 0

buyer_financing.description: Buyer has a mortgage (buyer pays the closing fee) or pays cash (closing fee split). Default mortgage

city_certificates.description: Override: municipal certificates. Default $500 in Chicago (water and zoning)

condo_packet.description: Override: association 22.1 packet cost. Default $450 for condos and townhomes

firm_title.description: Abdilla and Associates issues the owner's title policy. Default true

listing_broker_pct.description: Listing broker compensation in percent of price. Default 2.5

mortgage_payoff.description: Mortgage principal to pay off (0 if none)

mortgage_rate_pct.description: Mortgage interest rate in percent, used to estimate payoff interest

multiboard_8.description: Contract is on the Multi-Board Residential Real Estate Contract 8.0. Default true

municipality.description: Illinois city or village of the property, e.g. Chicago, Evanston, Oak Park

property_address.description: Optional street address, shown on the net sheet

survey.description: Override: survey cost. Default $500 for detached houses and 2 to 4 flats

tax_uplift_pct.description: Tax proration uplift over the last bill, percent. Default 5 (prorate at 105%)

name: estimate_seller_net_sheet
title: Chicago seller net sheet
